not: Sağır yılanın bacağı yoktur; her istemde 'legless, slithers like a snake' vurgusu bilerek tekrarlanır. Kamera hareketi yavaş tutulur ki video.py'deki diğer çekimlerle uyumlu olsun.

klipler.istem: The hand slowly lifts the flat stone a little higher, revealing more of the soil; the legless bronze slow worm underneath slowly shifts its coils and moves its small head, slithering like a snake. Gentle, slow camera push-in. Storybook watercolor style preserved.

The startled woman takes a step back in fright and raises the garden shovel defensively, her headscarf moving in the breeze; lettuce leaves sway gently. She does not strike anything. Slow subtle camera movement. Storybook watercolor style preserved.

Extreme close-up: the reptile slowly blinks, its eyelids closing fully over the eye and opening again, then blinks once more; tiny movements of the head, the background softly breathing. Static camera. Painterly style preserved.

The legless bronze slow worm slithers slowly forward through the leaf litter like a small snake, its glossy body gliding in smooth S-curves; ferns and leaves sway lightly, soft morning mist drifts. Slow camera pan following it. Storybook watercolor style preserved.

The small detached piece of tail on the ground twitches and wriggles; the blackbird hops toward it and pecks at it curiously, while the legless bronze slow worm slithers away into the tall grass and disappears. Slow camera. Storybook watercolor style preserved.

Rain falls gently; the legless bronze slow worm slithers slowly toward the small grey slug at the base of the lettuce, like a small snake, raindrops bouncing on the leaves. Slow camera push-in. Storybook watercolor style preserved.
